description: Daily supply and demand operations dataset by market. Includes demand, booked jobs, completed jobs, utilization, available slots, diagnostics, warranty checks, and service calls. Best for analyzing market-level supply-demand balance,capacity, utilization, and operational constraints.

Daily channel-by-market KPI dataset containing Month, Week, Day, market, and Channel Category dimensions, with core performance metrics including leads, jobs booked, canceled jobs, revenue, and jobs completed. Use this dataset to analyze daily lead volume, booking volume, cancellations, completed jobs, and revenue trends by market and channel.

Daily market-level marketing performance dataset containing ad delivery, traffic, lead generation, booking, completion, revenue, and acquisition efficiency metrics. Includes dimensions for day, week, month, and market, with metrics such as impressions, clicks, ctr, marketing_spend, cpc, leads, cost_per_inquiry, jobs_booked, booking_rate, jobs_completed, conversion_rate, revenue, and mac. Designed for trend analysis, market comparisons, and evaluating the relationship between marketing spend and downstream business outcomes.

Daily technician performance dataset with day, week, month, market, technician name, and active status dimensions. Includes revenue, booked revenue, average ticket, jobs per day, AOV completion rate, total repairs, completed jobs with invoice, repairs per job, cancel rate, completed jobs, and days worked. Use this dataset to analyze technician productivity, revenue generation, repair output, job conversion, cancellations, and workday utilization by technician and market.

Daily VIOC Referral store-level performance dataset containing Day, Month, Week, Store Number, Market, Regional, Area, and Store Manager dimensions, with referral performance and target metrics including Leads, Completed Jobs, Referral Target, Completed Target, and Monthly Referral Target. Use this dataset to analyze daily referral lead volume, completed referral jobs, store-level target attainment, and performance by store, manager, area, region, and market. Best for tracking VIOC referral productivity, comparing store performance, and monitoring progress against daily and monthly referral goals.

Daily front contact support dataset by market and issue type, containing Day, Week, Month, market, mapping status, inbox name, and issue type dimensions. Includes operational support metrics such as total issues, resolved issues, repeat issues, FCR issues, completed jobs, invoiced customer price, issues per completed job, repeat issue rate, and FCR based on the CS definition. Use this dataset to analyze daily customer support issue volume, resolution effectiveness, repeat contact behavior, and first contact resolution trends by market and issue category. Best for monitoring support quality, identifying issue hotspots, and measuring the relationship between support issues and downstream operational performance.

Daily cancellation reason and parts accuracy dataset by market, technician, supplier, and agent. Includes Day, Week, Month, market, cancellation reason, technician, supplier, and agent dimensions, with operational quality metrics such as total jobs, jobs with issue, issue rate, and accuracy rate. Use this dataset to analyze cancellation patterns, parts-related execution quality, and issue incidence across technicians, suppliers, and support agents. Best for identifying recurring cancellation drivers, monitoring parts and dispatch accuracy, and spotting operational breakdowns by market and owner.

Daily Google Business Listing performance dataset by market, channel, and store code. Includes Day, market, channel, store_code, store_tag, and Listing Age dimensions, with core GBL metrics including leads, jobs booked, canceled jobs, invoiced customer price, and jobs completed. Use this dataset to analyze listing-level lead generation, booking volume, cancellations, completed jobs, revenue, and performance by market, channel, store code, and listing maturity. Best for monitoring GBL productivity, comparing newer vs. older listings, identifying high-performing or underperforming store listings, and evaluating how listing age impacts downstream business outcomes.

Daily cancellation-level operations dataset containing Month, Week, appointment date, market, job number, technician, cancellation reason, withdrawn date, status, cancellation time frame, extra withdrawal notes, job link, original technician, and appointment create date dimensions. Use this dataset to analyze job cancellations by market, technician, reason category, status, timing, and operational owner. Best for identifying controllable HQ cancellation drivers, customer cancellation patterns, reschedule behavior, cancellation lead time, technician-related execution issues, and market-level cancellation trends.

Daily VELOCITY Referral store-level performance dataset containing Day, Month, Week, Store Number, Market, Regional, Area, and Store Manager dimensions, with referral performance and target metrics including Leads, Completed Jobs, Referral Target, Completed Target, and Monthly Referral Target. Use this dataset to analyze daily referral lead volume, completed referral jobs, store-level target attainment, and performance by store, manager, area, region, and market. Best for tracking VELOCITY referral productivity, comparing store performance, and monitoring progress against daily and monthly referral goals.

Daily sales event performance dataset containing Day, Week, Month, market, event, campaign, and channel dimensions, with sales activity and downstream performance metrics such as leads, jobs booked, completed jobs, canceled jobs, revenue, conversion rate, booking rate, cancel rate, and AOV. Use this dataset to analyze daily sales event performance, compare campaign/event effectiveness across markets, and evaluate how specific sales events contribute to lead generation, bookings, completions, and revenue. Best for tracking promotional event impact, identifying high-performing markets or campaigns, and measuring event-driven revenue outcomes.

Weekly VIOC Referral store-level performance dataset containing Day, Month, Week, Store Number, Market, Regional, Area, and Store Manager dimensions, with referral performance and target metrics including Leads, Completed Jobs, Referral Target, Completed Target, and Monthly Referral Target. Use this dataset to analyze daily referral lead volume, completed referral jobs, store-level target attainment, and performance by store, manager, area, region, and market. Best for tracking VIOC referral productivity, comparing store performance, and monitoring progress against daily and monthly referral goals.

Weekly listing-level search performance metrics from the GBL Search Tracker. Each record represents a unique combination of week, NuBrakes listing, keyword, and search engine, with metrics for search rankings, local pack visibility, organic visibility, search volume, and match performance. This dataset supports reporting on local SEO trends, listing health, review strategy, and geographic search visibility.

Daily market-level performance dataset combining completed jobs and customer reviews. Each record represents a unique day and market, with monthly and weekly rollups alongside total completed jobs and reviews generated. This dataset supports reporting on review conversion, review volume relative to operational activity, market-level review performance, and trends in post-service customer engagement.

Daily listing-level review dataset for NuBrakes locations. Each record represents a unique date and store location, with listing identifiers, address details, assigned market, weekly grouping, and the number of reviews received. This dataset supports reporting on review growth, store-level review performance, market comparisons, review routing strategy, listing maturity, and local search visibility.

Daily inquiry-level VIOC messaging dataset for NuBrakes. Each record represents a unique customer inquiry attributed to the VIOC channel, including inquiry date, market, ZIP code, campaign bucket, messaging tactic, language, UTM attribution, vehicle details, job status, revenue, customer urgency, and invoice information. This dataset supports reporting on VIOC campaign performance, email and flyer effectiveness, customer conversion, market-level trends, messaging attribution, booking outcomes, revenue generation, and referral strategy optimization.

Daily review-level ratings dataset for NuBrakes Google Business Profile locations. Each record represents a unique customer review for a specific store location and date, including location identifiers, address, store code, review ID, star rating, numeric rating, and review count. This dataset supports reporting on daily review volume, average star rating, rating distribution, low-rating identification, store-level reputation performance, market and location comparisons, review quality trends, listing health, and local search reputation monitoring.
